infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Ultra-Clear uses your location to show nearby experience centres and water refill ATMs.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Ultra-Clear uses your camera to take photos and record short videos for maintenance tickets.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Ultra-Clear uses your microphone to record audio with videos attached to maintenance tickets.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Ultra-Clear accesses your photo library to attach photos and videos to maintenance tickets.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Ultra-Clear reads your contacts so you can invite friends to join and earn referral rewards.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow Ultra-Clear to access your contacts to invite friends and earn referral rewards.
